newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso extends gains, closes at 1,042.50.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso extends gains, closes at 1,042.50.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed higher for the third consecutive day in a market that saw the local currency strengthen on dollar sales by banks and oil exporters, interbank dealers said.
They said the peso, which hit an intraday high of 1,041 before trending lower, closed at 1,042.50 to the dollar, up 2.5 pesos from Wednesday's close.
"There was a lot of volatility," one dealer said, adding that banks with long dollar positions were responsible for much of the peso's rise.

The dealer noted that trading was thin, however -- with just 207 operations for a below-average total of $84.5 million -- and said many market players appeared to be sidelined on expectations the peso will test resistance on Friday at 1,040.
"People are looking for it to get back to the 1,040 level," he said.
